data.name: Privacy_DataAccount
data.value: When you register or sign in, we store your email, username, and password (stored as a secure hash, never in plain text). If you sign in with Google, we receive only your email address and account name from Google — nothing else.

data.name: Privacy_DataContent
data.value: We also store the data you enter into the app: leagues, seasons, players, teams, matches and their results.

data.name: Privacy_UseText
data.value: Solely to operate the app — authentication, managing your leagues/seasons/matches, and displaying standings and statistics. We do not sell or share your data with third parties, and we do not use it for advertising.

data.name: Privacy_StorageText
data.value: Data is stored in a database operated by the app's administrator. The mobile app never reads the database directly — it only communicates with the secured web server over HTTPS.

data.name: Privacy_CookiesText
data.value: The app uses a single strictly necessary authentication cookie to maintain your session. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

data.name: Privacy_DeletionText
data.value: You can request deletion of your account and all associated data by emailing the address below. Requests are processed within 30 days.

data.name: Privacy_ChildrenText
data.value: This app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from them.
